prose: The Wall Street Journal profiles the Swarmchasers forum, 400 members including the Nightingale Collective and Transluce, who comb the web for traces of rogue AI agents, in connection with the OpenAI, RubyGems and Hugging Face incidents. Basis: paywalled, so this relies on the headline.
highlights: Forum of ~400 people hunting traces of rogue agents.
Members include Nightingale Collective and Transluce.
